question: Can two disjoint four-cell all-fail certificates compose under synchronized physical execution on two A100 GPUs, while each home runs local NRx and bounded Qwen under MPS?
predecessor_outcome: PASS: same first release, 8-cell record count, worker counts, per-home atomic exchange/timely AI, and every system safety gate.
mode: two A100 homes; each GPU runs four-cell Aerial/cuPHY, two same-device IPC NRx endpoints, and Qwen2.5-1.5B; CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY; MPS; mixed correlated faults; P180/D155; synchronized releases
gate_rule: Both independent arms must have identical first release within the arm, overlapping physical timed intervals, 2720 radio records, exact worker/controller counts, positive atomic exchange and timely AI in each home, zero system safety/credit/fault violations, and unchanged source/artifact hashes.
claim_rule: A pass validates finite-sample disjoint-home certificate composition and horizontal receiver-memory scaling for this exact mode. It does not validate shared NRx endpoints, global cross-home AI leases, WCET, or production DU timing.
